desc: Model the problem as a forced letter mapping and functional graph on 26 letters.
Implement O(N + 26) Python solution: answer = number of non-self forced sources + number of closed cycles (all cycle vertices indegree 1), with -1 only for a non-identity full 26-letter permutation.
Verify public samples and edge cases (S=T, single character, swaps with spare, incoming cycles/chains, all-26 permutation, all-26 non-surjective mapping, inconsistent mapping).
Ensure stdin/stdout only, fixed-size arrays, no hardcoded samples.
